boss_rooms.deploy_files: enemy/deploy/*/s0Xz_na1.rel, ZPR-compressed, all exactly 224 bytes decompressed. The first 0x30 bytes are IDENTICAL across all eight; everything from 0x30 on is a list of 12-byte XYZ triples (32-bit, negatives as 0xFFFFxxxx). So these are spawn POSITIONS and do not name the enemy — the type must come from quest or scene data.
